headline: Euro Area Inflation Expectations Rise for Third Consecutive Month in October
summary: Median consumer inflation expectations in the Euro Area for the next 12 months rose to 3.5% in October from 3.1% in September, while three-year expectations increased to 3%.
why: Consumer inflation expectations are closely monitored by the European Central Bank as a leading indicator of underlying price pressures and wage negotiations in the Eurozone.
